name: Example: Set Seeds
author: byo-pop examples
description: A seed makes a game's gems come out the same every time. Extras gets a field where you type the next game's seed, and every game can get a seed of its own, shown on the game-over screen, to play it again or pass it on. Changes nothing in play.

settings.label: Seed field in Extras
settings.help: Extras (in Options) gets a field for the seed of the next game.

settings.label: A seed for every game
settings.help: Every game gets a seed of its own, shown at game over, so you can play the same gems again.
